registered: 2026-11-18 ~11:35 ET, before any bar was fetched or any trade scored for this rule
operator: 11/18: 'My confidence would be if we were trending up or on a curl towards an upward trend, sideways and downward trends is low confidence' ... 'Especially if we've been some time below the entry price and never above it'
prior: the strict 'unless_up' double-check exit (sell unless both %R lines make a fresh 10-min high) lost 1.6-2.7 bp per cut on 7 replay days (memory never-green-cut-fails-every-version). This rule is looser: a curl or an up-slope is a hold, and it only acts on trades that have never been above entry.

data.trades: broker round trips, as tools/studies/flow_exit.load_trades (2026-09-16..11-18, desk-off 11/12-11/16 excluded, entries 09:31-15:45)
data.bars: SIP 1-minute bars for the traded symbols from the data-only account (tools/studies/loser_breakdown.api_bars)

rule_at_checkpoint_T_minutes.minutes: the T complete minutes after the fill minute (m_in+1 .. m_in+T)
rule_at_checkpoint_T_minutes.never_above: no minute high in those minutes above the buy fill price
rule_at_checkpoint_T_minutes.below_now: close of minute m_in+T below the fill price
rule_at_checkpoint_T_minutes.trend_up_or_curl (HOLD): least-squares slope of the last 5 closes > 0, OR a curl: last close > previous close AND last low > the lowest low of the 4 minutes before it
rule_at_checkpoint_T_minutes.exit: never_above AND below_now AND NOT trend_up_or_curl, trade still open at the end of minute m_in+T -> sell at that close minus 3 bp; otherwise keep the actual broker exit

comparison: PLAIN = never_above AND below_now, no trend condition (a timed never-green cut). The rule must beat PLAIN as well as holding.

split.train: entry day <= 2026-10-23: choose T from {3, 5, 10} by book delta
split.test: entry day >= 2026-10-26: the chosen T only, scored once

pass_if_ALL (test).book: mean delta per trade (rule - actual, 0 when untouched) >= +1.0 bp
pass_if_ALL (test).beats_plain: rule book delta >= PLAIN book delta + 1.0 bp
pass_if_ALL (test).both_halves: train book delta of the chosen T > 0

information: exited trades that were full stop-outs (<= -40 bp) vs later winners
same rule with %R fast pitch > 0 counted as a curl (not scored)
after_pass: build behind a switch (default off) in ai_positions; under the operator's 11/18 rule a PASS ships (paper)
caveats: minute bars (the live desk sees seconds and IEX); fills span several desk configs, judged per trade by delta
